expect_red: THE FENCE: the suggestion path colours faces and does nothing else -- it never selects, never highlights, never builds an event

mutations.contract: A face suggestion is a PROPOSAL IN THE UI and never a binding: the suggestion path colours candidates and does nothing else. It never picks one, and it never writes a feature-identity event -- the hard fence on handoff annotate_face_suggestions, and the whole reason the engine was allowed to exist.
mutations.note: The mutation is the exact temptation the fence is about, and the cheapest possible version of it: when the narrowing gets down to ONE candidate, select it for the reader. That is one line, it looks helpful, and it turns an eager-until-one-way-door surface into one that quietly makes identity decisions.
